title: Sebastian and the Contact
author: Noor Oyelaran
blurb: Paloma Quintana, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
